note: Both sets correctly capture the keynote list (DISHWASHER 11 31 13.A7, DOMESTIC WATER PIPING 22 11 16, SUMP PUMP 22 11 23.A2, HTP SUPERSTOR SOLAR WATER TANK 22 33 00), the TOP OF STEEL 11'-5" and INT. STEP 2'-6 1/8" dimensions in the west elevation, and the 1/2" = 1'-0" scale. Set A, however, contains a fabricated dimension "STEP 1 1/8"" (the sheet only shows INT. STEP 2'-6 1/8") and misbinds the sheet title fragment "MECHANICAL" as the title of drawing C1 (C1 is MECHANICAL ROOM LAYOUT). Set B invents nothing and adds two facts A misses — the drawing number P-401 and the SOLAR PUMP STATION keynote 23 56 01 — while binding the elevations and keynotes correctly. Both sets pad with vague "connection | system/component" and bare-tag claims (B has a few more of these), but B has no misread or invented values, so it is the more faithful set.
